western.aries.name: Aries
western.aries.description: Aries is traditionally associated with courage, determination, and enthusiasm. As the first sign of the zodiac, it is often linked to leadership, initiative, and a pioneering spirit.
western.taurus.name: Taurus
western.taurus.description: Taurus is traditionally associated with reliability, patience, and practicality. It is linked to a love of beauty, comfort, and stability.
western.gemini.name: Gemini
western.gemini.description: Gemini is traditionally associated with adaptability, communication, and intellectual curiosity. It is linked to versatility, wit, and a love of learning.
western.cancer.name: Cancer
western.cancer.description: Cancer is traditionally associated with deep emotional sensitivity, intuition, and strong family bonds. It is linked to nurturing, protectiveness, and loyalty.
western.leo.name: Leo
western.leo.description: Leo is traditionally associated with creativity, warmth, and self-confidence. It is linked to generosity, leadership, and a dramatic, passionate nature.
western.virgo.name: Virgo
western.virgo.description: Virgo is traditionally associated with analytical thinking, attention to detail, and a methodical approach to life. It is linked to service, practicality, and a desire for order.
western.libra.name: Libra
western.libra.description: Libra is traditionally associated with balance, harmony, and a strong sense of justice. It is linked to diplomacy, social grace, and an appreciation for beauty.
western.scorpio.name: Scorpio
western.scorpio.description: Scorpio is traditionally associated with intensity, passion, and resourcefulness. It is linked to determination, emotional depth, and transformative power.
western.sagittarius.name: Sagittarius
western.sagittarius.description: Sagittarius is traditionally associated with optimism, freedom, and a love of travel and philosophy. It is linked to adventure, honesty, and intellectual exploration.
western.capricorn.name: Capricorn
western.capricorn.description: Capricorn is traditionally associated with discipline, responsibility, and ambition. It is linked to self-control, good management, and a practical approach to life.
western.aquarius.name: Aquarius
western.aquarius.description: Aquarius is traditionally associated with progressive thinking, independence, and humanitarianism. It is linked to originality, innovation, and a desire for social change.
western.pisces.name: Pisces
western.pisces.description: Pisces is traditionally associated with compassion, artistic talent, and deep intuition. It is linked to empathy, wisdom, and a strong connection to the spiritual world.
chinese.rat.name: Rat
chinese.rat.description: The Rat is traditionally associated with cleverness, resourcefulness, and adaptability.
chinese.ox.name: Ox
chinese.ox.description: The Ox is traditionally associated with diligence, dependability, and strength.
chinese.tiger.name: Tiger
chinese.tiger.description: The Tiger is traditionally associated with bravery, competitiveness, and confidence.
chinese.rabbit.name: Rabbit
chinese.rabbit.description: The Rabbit is traditionally associated with gentleness, elegance, and compassion.
chinese.dragon.name: Dragon
chinese.dragon.description: The Dragon is traditionally the most revered sign, associated with power, strength, and good fortune.
chinese.snake.name: Snake
chinese.snake.description: The Snake is traditionally associated with wisdom, intuition, and sophistication.
chinese.horse.name: Horse
chinese.horse.description: The Horse is traditionally associated with energy, freedom, and enthusiasm.
chinese.goat.name: Goat
chinese.goat.description: The Goat is traditionally associated with creativity, gentleness, and compassion.
chinese.monkey.name: Monkey
chinese.monkey.description: The Monkey is traditionally associated with wit, intelligence, and playfulness.
chinese.rooster.name: Rooster
chinese.rooster.description: The Rooster is traditionally associated with confidence, honesty, and punctuality.
chinese.dog.name: Dog
chinese.dog.description: The Dog is traditionally associated with loyalty, honesty, and kindness.
chinese.pig.name: Pig
chinese.pig.description: The Pig is traditionally associated with generosity, compassion, and diligence.
